hypotheses.justification: Agreement on root subgroups already implies agreement on the torus. The source lemma kostantCoordinateCocharacter_torusCharacter_mem_kostantElementarySubgroup, applied to a torus point supported at i with value u, puts the i-th coordinate-cocharacter at u² in the elementary subgroup: rootGeneratorWeight_inl and cartanMatrix_apply_same give exponent 2, and isSl2Triple_geckRepresentation supplies the triple. Taking products, every represented coordinatewise-square torus point is elementary. Thus hroot gives agreement after precomposing the torus restrictions with the squaring morphism. Its coordinate map on ℤ[Fin t.rank →₀ ℤ] sends each monomial indexed by m to that indexed by 2m and is injective, since doubling integer exponent vectors is injective. Cancel this map on coordinate morphisms to obtain htorus, then use the original proof. This does not assume units have square roots or Cartan rows are primitive; the argument also covers rank one, characteristic-two points, and an empty index set.
